lines.text: д. Савино Пышминскго района Свердловской области
lines.latin: d. Savino Pyshminskgo rayona Sverdlovskoy oblasti

notes: Village Savino, Pyshma district, Sverdlovsk Oblast. Gilt-framed plaque in Old-Russian-style display letters. The plaque really spells 'Пышминскго' (missing о; correct form Пышминского); kept as written. Small 'ВИДЕО наблюдение' CCTV sticker at left is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
